title: Require direct human report before every archive
outOfScope: Merging, rebasing, or changing the superseded draft PR #460.
Provider PR approval, merge, branch-deletion, or release mechanics.
Claiming that a repository script can itself post into an external conversation.

sources.reason: Records the user's correction that every human-facing Work Item report occurs while active and before archive, regardless of whether later PR creation is manual or explicitly authorized automation.
ai-finish is the completed-local-verification, active-state pre-archive boundary that can render a truthful report.
Outcome integration, core finish, adopter lifecycle, and journey tests provide the direct regression boundary for a report generated after verification and before any provider PR exists.
Operating rules must require conversation delivery before push/PR regardless of the authorized PR-creation method.
Documents the distinct PR-preparation human report and post-merge closure evidence roles.

riskAssessment.reason: A report emitted after push or PR violates the user-required decision point, while a report that implies provider state before it exists would mislead. The report must be derived only from verified local Outcome/Summary facts and label provider PR state as not created.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly corrected the timing rule and directed continued implementation; the ai-finish, rule, documentation, and test boundaries are concrete.

preReviewWarnings: Do not infer that a push, PR, approval, merge, or Hosted CI exists at the pre-PR report point.
Do not make PR creation conditional on report-path reading; the direct text must be delivered in the conversation first.
The rule applies identically to manual PR creation and explicitly authorized automation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A successful ai-finish emits a titled Human pre-archive report after local verification and mandatory pre-merge Outcome generation, leaves the Work Item active, and does not permit archive, push, or PR creation.

The report directly states Work Item, delivered local changes, verified local evidence, residual risks or none, Provider PR state not created, and next action/authority boundary; Outcome paths are optional audit links after the decision facts.

Focused integration tests fail when the report is absent, path-first, emitted before verified Outcome state, missing required local facts, claims provider PR state other than not_created, or permits archive without the separate confirmation gate; they pass for a valid active-state result.

AGENTS.md and Task Outcome documentation require the executor to send the pre-archive report to the human conversation, wait for human confirmation, and only then archive before any push or PR creation, whether that later creation is manual or separately permitted automation.

RFE-099 completes Contract, Preflight, before-edit checkpoint, verification, direct human report and confirmation, archive, PR, exact-head Hosted CI, merge, Closure Receipt, and branch cleanup before #441 resumes.
guidelines: Derive the pre-archive report exclusively from verified local Contract, Summary, and Outcome facts; state provider PR as not created.
Use a fixed concise report shape that answers human decision questions before optional audit paths.
Test report timing and facts through ai-finish integration behavior, not source-text-only assertions.
Document conversation delivery as executor responsibility and make no false claim that repository code controls external chat or provider action.
Keep instruction-design-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability bidirectional and keep #441 paused until this corrective closes.

intent.problem: The user corrected the report lifecycle boundary: both template and adopter projects need the direct human report after implementation and verification but while the Work Item remains active, before archive. Whether a later PR is manually opened or opened by a separately permitted automation must not alter the report timing. The unmerged RFE-098 draft instead added a post-merge direct report, so it must not merge as the solution.
constraints: Generate the report only after local verification and pre-merge Outcome evidence exist, while the Work Item remains active and before archive, push, or PR creation.
State that provider PR facts do not yet exist; do not infer Hosted CI, approval, merge, or cleanup.
Require executor delivery to the human conversation and explicit human archive confirmation before archive, push/PR for both manual and separately permitted automated PR workflows.
Keep Outcome and Closure Receipt as auditable evidence rather than requiring people to read them for the decision summary.
Do not mutate archived RFE-098 evidence or merge its draft PR.
intent.rationale: A pre-archive report makes the human decision surface occur at the common control point before immutable archival or provider-facing change. It preserves separate post-merge lifecycle evidence without confusing it with the report that authorizes reviewable external change.

rawUserRequest: 对象工程是手动PR，报告是否应该是PR前报告？我觉得，模版工程和对象工程，时间点都应该是PR之前。模版工程的自动PR是因为得到了我的授权。所以不应该区分模版工程和对象工程。流程上应该是一样的时间点。我又想了下，应该是在归档前。Agent工单完成，此时是active状态。先报告，人确认以后，如果有问题，可以根据报告继续补充。继续。当前的计划执行，我已经授权确认和继续，不需要停止。对计划中的工单，也都是已授权。所以按照目标进行。

declaredIntent.summary: Require one direct, decision-first human report while every completed Work Item remains active and before archive, independent of the later authorized PR-creation method.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add an ai-finish integration test that uses a verified Outcome state and asserts ordered output.
